aspectRatio.description: The floating-point aspect ratio of the field of view. When undefined, the camera uses the viewport's aspect ratio.

yfov.title: Y FoV
yfov.description: The vertical field of view in radians.

zfar.title: Z Far
zfar.description: The distance to the far clipping plane. When undefined, the far clipping plane is at infinity.

znear.title: Z Near
znear.description: The floating-point distance to the near clipping plane.
